title: 去公园

explanations.1: It indicates the time of the activity, fitting the context of a morning trip.
explanations.2: It shows that the speaker and family members acted together, common in daily routine.
explanations.3: It introduces the starting point ‘home’, required for describing departure.
explanations.4: It is a location noun indicating the inside of the park, naturally used with ‘park’.
explanations.5: It describes the quantity of flowers and trees, a common way to express abundance.
explanations.6: It links the adjective ‘beautiful’ to the noun ‘flowers’, a basic grammatical structure.
explanations.7: It orders actions chronologically, showing the first thing they did after arriving.
explanations.8: It is the main verb for consuming food, fitting the picnic context.
explanations.9: It is a common food item eaten during a picnic, matching the scenario.
explanations.10: It connects the action of drinking to the previous action of eating, showing parallelism.
explanations.11: It is the measure word for drinks in a cup, appropriate for water.
explanations.12: It marks the time when they returned home, continuing the timeline.
explanations.13: It describes the action of returning to home, a natural end to the park trip.
explanations.14: It indicates the sequence ‘after arriving home’, used with time expressions.
explanations.15: It expresses ability, fitting the context of knowing how to fly a kite.

translation: This morning, I went to the park together with my family, starting from home. There are many beautiful flowers and trees inside the park. We first took a walk by the lake. Then we had a picnic on the lawn. I ate bread and fruit. I also drank a cup of water. In the afternoon, we went home. After arriving home, I rested for a while. In the evening, our whole family watched TV. Dad can fly a kite, but the wind is not strong. Younger sister cannot fly it, so she played with toys. Mom brought some apples, which are very fresh. I feel really happy today. This is a wonderful weekend.
